title: Herbal Tonic Fertile Supplement(ZO2C5)
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether the effect of mixed herbals drug (citrus, citrolus vol, lan, carrot seed, zingiber, onion, basil, cinnamon) administration on male infertility: oligospermia
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* all patients suffering from oligospermia are included

Exclusion Criteria:

* any diseases
